packages.title: A sale, however it was tendered

evidence.note: 1,648 pure cash, 290 pure BCA debit, 2 split cash+card, 3 with a return. Every one of them debits Harga Pokok Pembelian and credits Persediaan exactly once.

caveats: Revenue is posted NET of discount and the discount never appears as a line. The client's own sale documents carry no discount account, so a gross-plus-contra shape would invent one — and posting both a gross revenue and a discount contra is how the same reduction gets taken off twice.
Cost of goods is ONE pair of lines per sale, computed from the sale, never from the tenders. A per-tender cost is the defect this rule exists to make impossible.
A card tender is banked directly, because that is what the client does. The clearing-receivable model is a separate package and it is off.

packages.title: Card sales land in a clearing receivable instead of the bank

evidence.note: A deliberate change of accounting policy, not current practice. It would make the bank balance agree with the bank from the first day and turn the period-end reclass into a settlement match. It also changes what every past comparative means, so it is a decision for the client and not a default.

activation.blocked_reason: A policy change nobody has approved. Mutually exclusive with card_reclass.

packages.title: Head office sends stock to a shop (Surat Jalan Distribusi)

evidence.note: Every one: Dr BDP Barang Dagangan WIRAMODE - C006 / Cr Hutang Affiliasi Atas Barang HEAD OFFICE - C006. Rp470,488,453.26 of debits in the month.

caveats: The GOODS payable, not the financing one. The client keeps three affiliate families and they are not interchangeable.
Head office's mirror leg is not posted here: this fixture holds the shop's book only, and the HO journal has not been supplied.

packages.title: The shop receives the stock and BDP clears

evidence.note: No receipt journal has been supplied. July shows 147 BDP debits and zero credits, while sales credit Persediaan — so something moves BDP into inventory and nobody has shown us what. Two shapes are plausible and they are not equivalent: BDP → Persediaan at receipt, or BDP → Persediaan at sale. The balances differ by whatever is on the shelf, which is the whole point of an inventory account.

activation.blocked_reason: Waiting on the receipt-side journal. Asked for as P0 in the revised matrix.

packages.title: The shop banks its takings to head office

evidence.note: Dr Hutang Affiliasi Atas Barang HEAD OFFICE - C006 / Cr Cash on Hand C006. The takings do not leave as revenue; they pay down what the shop owes for goods.

packages.title: Card takings not yet cleared move to a receivable

evidence.note: Dr Piutang Debit Card C006 / Cr Cash In Bank Tabungan Bank BCA C006. The bank was credited at checkout; at the period end the part that has not settled is moved out again.

caveats: This preserves current practice. It is the counterpart of a clearing model, not a step towards one — the two are alternatives and only one may be active.

packages.title: The acquirer pays, net of its fee

evidence.note: Dr Cash In Bank Tabungan Bank BCA + Dr Credit Card Expenses / Cr Piutang Debit Card.

packages.title: The month's payroll becomes a cost and a liability

evidence.note: Dr Biaya Gaji Karyawan 57,250,000 + Biaya Asuransi/BPJS 3,163,228 / Cr Biaya Gaji dan Upah YMHD 57,250,000 + Biaya Asuransi dan BPJS YMHD 3,163,228. Two separate YMHD accounts, which is why this rule has two credit lines and not one.

caveats: Salary and benefits are separate liabilities and must stay separate lines: one settles to the staff and the other to BPJS, on different days, and a single lumped accrual cannot be allocated against.
Outside help (GAJI PETUGAS LUAR) is NOT accrued — the client pays it in the same document and codes it straight to Biaya Rumah Tangga. It is a direct expense on the payment, not a payroll liability.
The client accrues, funds and pays on the same day (31 July). Nothing in this package assumes the first of the month.

packages.title: Head office sends a unit money

evidence.note: Dr PETTY CASH C006 61,913,500 / Cr Hutang Lain-lain Principal HEAD OFFICE - C006. Payroll money arrives against PRINCIPAL, not against the financing account — which is why funding_type is a required field and never inferred.

caveats: Lines 2 and 3 are alternatives chosen by funding_type, never both. What SELECTS between financing and principal is still an open policy question — the engine refuses an event that does not say rather than defaulting to one of them.

packages.title: An asset is bought and paid for

evidence.note: Dr FFE Office C006 348,276 / Cr Cash In Bank Tabungan Bank BCA C006. The acquisition IS the payment document — there is no separate capitalisation entry, which is why registering the asset afterwards must not post a second one.

caveats: A bank charge in the same document is NOT part of the asset. The client's air-conditioner BKK carries Rp5,000 of ADM alongside Rp26,390,000 of asset cost, and the split cannot be inferred from the document total.
Installation billed separately IS part of the cost, and arrives as a second event against the same asset. See ASSET_COST_ADDITION.

packages.title: The month's depreciation

evidence.note: Nine charge lines totalling Rp4,683,970 across four FFE classes at C006. Every one reconciles to a row of the client's own MASTER ASSET register at cost ÷ life in months, TRUNCATED, not rounded.

caveats: One line per asset, not per class. The client's own entry carries nine lines for four classes, so a run that summed by class would produce an entry their accountant cannot tie back to a row of the register.
Re-running a month is a no-op: the idempotency key is the book, the period and the run, so the second press returns the first entry.

packages.title: Operating equipment is replaced

evidence.note: The owner's instruction: a replacement purchase becomes replacement expense directly. It does not add to the register, does not start a depreciation schedule, and does not draw a reserve. The register's value for the original stays as it is.

caveats: Not Dr REPLACEMENT_RESERVE. Drawing the reserve would be right only if the reserve had been accrued, and it has not — see OE_RESERVE_ACCRUED, which is off.
No asset row is created and no schedule starts. That is the point of the rule.

packages.title: A monthly replacement reserve for operating equipment

evidence.note: The only support is that 1021607* and 7010215* exist, 36 classes each. C006 posted to neither in July 2026 while holding 15 operating-equipment rows worth about Rp190 million. The owner's instruction says not to accrue one because the account is there. Two independent designs in this repository assumed otherwise.

activation.blocked_reason: No evidence of a monthly accrual, and an explicit instruction not to invent one. Needs: a rate, a basis, and one actual reserve journal.
